messages:
kai.re: Prospect 'Driftline' wants a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Main asks: minimal client changes (shim), how to map their per-response bands to our per-token pricing, SCIM + BYOK, and notes on response deltas breaking their ranking model. Can presales/eng advise?
mira.se: I can lead the adapter. We'll preserve the external API shape and translate to /v1/completions. Heads-up: tokenizer differences and default sampling params will cause output variance.
jon.engineering: Tokenization typically shifts length by ~5-10 tokens depending on languages and punctuation. Stop-sequence semantics differ too; if their parser expects exact truncation that can break downstream scoring.
anya.security: Security asks: SCIM, SSO, BYOK (AWS/GCP KMS), IP allowlist, audit export. Also they require a SOC2 addendum and EU data residency options. Need their compliance contact and sample ACLs.
rachel.solutions: Proposal: 1) collect 250 representative calls across intents; 2) run parity A/B (CompetitorX vs Redwood + quantized); 3) compute major-regression rate and token distribution per-band; 4) produce cost projection for finance.
kai.re: They bill S/M/L buckets. Can we provide a conversion example for finance?
rachel.solutions: Yes. Sample 500 responses from each bucket, compute avg tokens per bucket, then monthly cost = avg_tokens * per_token_rate * monthly_request_volume. I'll prepare a Colab for them.
mira.se: Adapter mapping example: CompetitorX POST /gen {"prompt":"...","size":"M"} -> Redwood POST /v1/completions {"model":"redwood-x","input":"...","max_output_tokens":<derived>} with stop_sequences normalized. Add output-normalizer to mimic their stop truncation.
jon.engineering: Engineering caveat: if their ranking expects exact token offsets for entities, tokenization diffs can misalign spans. We can add a best-effort char-to-token mapping in the shim but document edge cases.
anya.security: I'll start the SA design doc and request their legal/compliance contact. Also confirm whether they need HSM-backed keys.
kai.re: Acceptance criteria idea: (a) parity suite <=3% major regressions, (b) P95 latency under 700ms at their projected load (~120 TPS), (c) cost projection within 12% after sampling, (d) security questionnaire signed.
rachel.solutions: Timeline: day 0-2 onboarding + security kickoff; day 3-5 adapter + smoke tests; day 6-8 run parity suite & billing sampling; day 9 demo.
mira.se: I'll open a proxy repo and post initial smoke logs by EOD tomorrow.
kai.re: Thanks all 1. Keeping this thread as the single source for POC updates. :thumbsup:
